State Of Alaska Department Of Revenue increased its stake in Intel Corp (INTC) by 12.71% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. State Of Alaska Department Of Revenue bought 112,555 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.97% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 997,793 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $47.18 million, up from 885,238 at the end of the previous reported quarter. State Of Alaska Department Of Revenue who had been investing in Intel Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $207.98 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 4.55% or $2.17 during the last trading session, reaching $45.57. About 535 shares traded. Intel Corporation (NASDAQ:INTC) has risen 9.59% since December 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.59% the S&P500.
State Of Alaska Department Of Revenue, which manages about $5.95B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Northrop Grumman Corp (NYSE:NOC) by 15,458 shares to 29,016 shares, valued at $9.21 million in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Becton Dickinson & Co (NYSE:BDX) by 20,395 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 48,228 shares, and cut its stake in Clorox Co Del (NYSE:CLX).
